defs: Infrastructure as Code: defining and provisioning infrastructure through version-controlled code/templates.

course.learn: This section focuses on **Key Concepts** within **Infrastructure as code (IaC)**. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) defines infrastructure and configuration in machine-readable templates or code so environments can be deployed consistently and automatically.
course.why: Automation improves repeatability, but an insecure template can reproduce the same mistake everywhere.
course.example: A Terraform template creates networks, security groups, and servers through version-controlled code reviewed before deployment.
course.exam: Benefits: consistency, automation, versioning. Risks: secrets in code, insecure templates, overly broad permissions, and rapid propagation of mistakes.
